name: s3_read_ch
purpose: TASKS 219, second half: S3's read on the CH-stretch window, with the verdict model S2b's CH read chooses, predicting coronene's and tetracene's CH stretches. Registered in GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-14_CH_Stretch_Anharmonic_Read.md; what is printed follows PreRegistration_2026-11-14_Printed_Band_Position.md - the step only if it beats the harmonic position by this read's own numbers, and no licence is claimed (a -170 cm-1 correction to 3 cm-1 would be 2 %). Waits for s2b_read_ch, whose s2b_read.json it reads
command: bash ../../wait_then_run.sh s2b_read_ch.log '^=== \(S2BC\) done' -- env WINDOW=ch MARKED=exclude LABELS=probes/results_m1/labels_domain_2026-11-13 TARGETS=probes/results_m1/labels_domain_2026-11-13/S3_targets/targets.json S2B=probes/results_m1/labels_domain_2026-11-13/s2b_read_ch/s2b_read.json OUT=probes/results_m1/labels_domain_2026-11-13/s3_read_ch bash ../../s3_read.sh

estimate.basis: the mid-window S3 read's own hour (every model is fitted once on the training molecules), plus the wait for s2b_read_ch

memory.basis: the mid-window S3 read's own: one CPU python with torch, the molecules' mode arrays under 100 MB
